name: Iran
description: Iran from Elam and the Persian empires to Islam, the Safavids, the Pahlavi shahs, the revolution of 1979 and the Islamic Republic.

checkpoints.name: Ancient Iran
checkpoints.note: Elam ruled from Susa. Cyrus founded the Persian empire in the 500s BCE, and the Parthians and Sasanians later fought Rome.

checkpoints.name: Islamic Iran
checkpoints.note: Arab armies brought Islam. Persian culture flowered again with Ferdowsi, Avicenna and Hafez, through Seljuk and Mongol rule.

checkpoints.name: Shahs
checkpoints.note: The Safavids made Iran Shia and built Isfahan. A revolution won a parliament in 1906, and the Pahlavi shahs modernised by force.

checkpoints.name: The Islamic Republic
checkpoints.note: The revolution of 1979 brought Khomeini to power. War with Iraq followed, and protests have challenged the clerics again and again.
